verdict.rationale: Grafana documents an as-code and provisioning approach. Dashboards, data sources and "other configurations" can be defined in files, kept in version control, and deployed through CI/CD with a terminal CLI. Review and rollback therefore come only indirectly, via Git workflows, rather than as a native capability. The evidence never explicitly covers alert rules or other automations, which are the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit versioning of alert rules and automations, built-in review and approval workflows, a native rollback or version-history feature, and independent hands-on corroboration.
